pages._note: Mailing lists as a declarative type:index page. Nothing here needs a component: the fields are flat, the row action opens the detail page, and Add is the standard create dialog. That is the ADR-031 and ADR-049 default, and the reason the list detail page below is not one is stated on that page.
pages.title: Lists

pages._note: Mailing list record as a declarative type:detail page. The list's own fields (name, opt-in mode, sender identity, footer address, status) auto-render in the body via CnObjectDataWidget. The subscriptions table stays a kind:'section' bodyWidget for two reasons no declarative primitive covers: (1) a membership row is read through its STATE, so each row needs a chip vocabulary mapping pending/confirmed/unsubscribed/bounced to a colour and a label, and the object-list widget renders a value, not a chip; (2) the page leads with per-state counts, and summaryAggregates filters are equality-only over one schema and cannot break one field out into four counts on one strip. The section self-fetches GET /api/mailing-lists/{id}/subscriptions, which returns both in one envelope.
